title: Jump from a Board tile to a thread on the canvas

trigger.text: Dana sees an open thread on a Board tile and needs the full-size screen to judge it.

goal: The thread opens on the full-size screen without searching for it.
outcome: The Screens view shows the screen with that thread's popover open.

steps.action: Clicks the thread's pin on the tile; the read-only preview opens
Chooses Open in Screens in the preview
Switches to the Screens view, selects the screen and opens the thread's popover at its element
Returns to the Board with the same filter and zoom
